title: Indonesia asks Google to clarify removal of 19,000 YouTube channels, ministry says
summary: Google routinely publishes a quarterly "influence operations bulletin", containing reports of terminations of accounts linked to countries such as China, India, and Indonesia as part of its "investigation into coordinated influence operations."
llm_summary: Google’s quarterly “influence‑operations bulletin” lists thousands of accounts it has shut down for being part of coordinated campaigns, and the latest report includes about 19,000 YouTube channels tied to Indonesia. The Indonesian ministry has asked Google to explain why those channels were removed, saying the move could affect local creators and public discourse.
